title: Environmental recurrence changes the transmission advantage of private memory in a finite-budget population model

creators.name: Chen, Jack
creators.affiliation: Frederick Sequencing and Genomics Core; Advanced Biomedical Computational Science (ABCS); Frederick National Lab for Cancer Research; National Institutes of Health

description: A computational preprint separating the transmission advantage of historical memory use from absolute lineage increase and population accuracy in an abstract finite-budget population model. Includes studies 045–055, complete block-level outcome grids, scientific source and reproducibility scripts. Not externally peer reviewed. The compact release excludes raw candidate-by-candidate trajectories and random tapes. Content/data are CC BY 4.0; original code is MIT.
